author: packs
description: ITSM on the service ticket. Configuration items (H5-T1): one CI entity with a class (server, application, database, network device, service), relationship types with direction and the typed relationships between CIs. Incidents (H1-T1): urgency, major-incident manager, affected CI and restore time on the ticket (which already carries type, impact, priority and the major flag), and the post-incident review with its actions. Problems (H2-T1): problems, the incidents linked to them and known errors with their workaround and knowledge article. Changes (H3-T1): change requests with type, risk, planned window, implementation, back-out and test plans, affected CIs and pre-approved standard change templates. Releases (H4-T1): releases grouping changes and tasks with a go/no-go decision.
name: itsm
title: Pack: IT service management
